edits.find: GTPS essentials An overuse tendinopathy of the gluteus medius and minimus at the greater trochanter — "trochanteric bursitis" is a misnomer, since the bursa usually isn't the source. Risk factors: age ≥50, women > men, obesity, and lower-limb or low-back disorders. Clinical diagnosis; X-ray excludes hip joint disease rather than confirming GTPS. Ladder: activity modification + NSAIDs + physical therapy (abductor strengthening) → corticosteroid injection if refractory.
